Injury opportunity: Colby Parkinson (TE, LAR) steps in for Terrance Ferguson (Doubtful) and nobody has him - proj 5.1, under the radar. 1 free next-men in total.
Woody Marks (BN2, value 6.2/wk) - Upgrade after this week (his best week is now): drop for Kalif Raymond (+4.2/wk)

Waiver: worth a claim - Kalif Raymond (WR, CHI, value 10.5/wk) - Covers your most exposed spot - WR has 8.5 starter-week(s) at risk with Wan'Dale Robinson (11.1) behind them; +4.2/wk over your weakest bench, weighted x1.5; fade risk (92% of seasons like his fall off); last 3 weeks 15.5 ppg; rising; drop Woody Marks (+4.2/wk) (also on 2 rival wish list(s))
Morgan is shopping Alvin Kamara, Tyler Warren: nothing there beats what you would have to give - pass, or wait for the price to drop

Plan: claim Spencer Shrader (IND, 9.8/wk) for that week and drop Woody Marks (RB, 6.2/wk, your least valuable bench man) to hold both; drop Spencer Shrader again in week 6 when Harrison Butker is back
Week 5 bye: Chiefs D/ST (DST #9) - replaceable, and worth no more than Woody Marks. Stream him: claim Texans D/ST (HOU, 6.3/wk) that week in his spot, then take the best free DST back in week 6
Next week: Harrison Butker is on bye - plan the replacement now
Quentin Johnston: 137,221 teams dropped him in the last day (rostered 56%). The crowd is bailing
